description: This Java class defines a data model for encapsulating search criteria used to query encounters within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes various filtering parameters such as patient, location, date range, encounter types, providers, visits, and whether to include voided encounters. It provides constructors to instantiate search criteria objects and getter methods to access the criteria fields.

classes.name: EncounterSearchCriteria
classes.description: A class representing various search filters for querying encounters in OpenMRS, with a constructor and getter methods for each filter.

methods.name: EncounterSearchCriteria
methods.description: Constructor to initialize an EncounterSearchCriteria object with specified filtering parameters.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Returns the Patient object associated with the search criteria.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the Location object where the encounter took place.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the starting date (inclusive) for the encounter filtering.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the ending date (exclusive) for the encounter filtering.

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the date when the encounter was last changed.

methods.name: getEnteredViaForms
methods.description: Returns the collection of Form objects that the encounter must be entered through.

methods.name: getEncounterTypes
methods.description: Returns the collection of EncounterType objects to filter encounters.

methods.name: getProviders
methods.description: Returns the collection of Provider objects associated with the encounters.

methods.name: getVisitTypes
methods.description: Returns the collection of VisitType objects related to the encounters.

methods.name: getVisits
methods.description: Returns the collection of Visit objects related to the encounters.

methods.name: getIncludeVoided
methods.description: Returns whether voided encounters are included in the search.
